indicators.flag: The company never received exports prior to February 24, 2022;
indicators.red_flag: Non-GECC importer with no pre-Feb-2022 export history newly receiving controlled goods
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D15 (Trade-finance / customs / shipping & logistics data), not currently held → source data first.

indicators.flag: The company received exports that did not include any of the nine HS Codes prior to February 24, 2022;
indicators.red_flag: Importer with no prior nine-HS-code history now receiving High-Priority-Items-List goods
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D15 (Trade-finance / customs / shipping & logistics data), not currently held → source data first.

indicators.flag: The company received exports involving the nine HS Codes prior to February 24, 2022, but also saw a significant spike in exports thereafter.
indicators.red_flag: Post-invasion spike in nine-HS-code export volume vs baseline
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D15 (Trade-finance / customs / shipping & logistics data), not currently held → source data first.

indicators.flag: Evaluating the customer’s date of incorporation (e.g., incorporation after February 24, 2022),
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C13 (Account-opening / KYC risk profiling).

indicators.flag: Evaluating the end user and end use of the item (e.g., whether the customer’s line of business is consistent with the ordered items),
indicators.red_flag: End-use / line-of-business inconsistent with ordered dual-use items
indicators.rationale: Partially covered by C22 (Trade-based money-laundering & documentary anomaly detection); data D15.

indicators.flag: Evaluating whether the customer’s physical location and public-facing website raise any red flags (e.g., business address is a residence, no website is available).
indicators.red_flag: Residential business address / no web presence on trade counterparty (OSINT)
indicators.rationale: Partially covered by C19 (Adverse-media / OSINT & web-presence verification); data D13.

indicators.section: New Transactional and Behavioral Red Flags
indicators.flag: Transactions related to payments for defense or dual-use products from a company incorporated after February 24, 2022, and based in a non-GECC country.
indicators.red_flag: Dual-use-goods payment from post-Feb-2022 non-GECC newco
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C20 (Cross-border / high-risk-jurisdiction & corridor anomaly detection).

indicators.section: New Transactional and Behavioral Red Flags
indicators.flag: A new customer whose line of business is in trade of products associated with the nine HS codes, is based in a non-GECC country, and was incorporated after February 24, 2022.
indicators.red_flag: New non-GECC newco trading the nine controlled HS-code commodities
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C13 (Account-opening / KYC risk profiling).

indicators.section: New Transactional and Behavioral Red Flags
indicators.flag: An existing customer who did not receive exports associated with the nine HS codes prior to February 24, 2022, but who is receiving such items now.
indicators.red_flag: Existing customer newly receiving nine-HS-code goods vs no prior history (out-of-pattern)
indicators.rationale: Partially covered by C1 (Customer-profile / out-of-pattern transaction monitoring); data D15.

indicators.section: New Transactional and Behavioral Red Flags
indicators.flag: An existing customer, based outside the United States, received exports associated with one or more of the nine HS codes prior to February 24, 2022, and requested or received a significant increase in exports with those same codes thereafter.
indicators.red_flag: Foreign existing customer spikes nine-HS-code export volume post-invasion vs baseline
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C6 (Transaction-velocity & dormancy / baseline-deviation monitoring).

indicators.section: New Transactional and Behavioral Red Flags
indicators.flag: A customer lacks or refuses to provide details to banks, shippers, or third parties, including about end users, intended end-use, or company ownership.
indicators.red_flag: Customer refuses end-user / end-use / ownership disclosure (KYC non-cooperation)
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D8 (KYC / CDD & beneficial-ownership data), not currently held → source data first.

indicators.section: New Transactional and Behavioral Red Flags
indicators.flag: Transactions involving smaller-volume payments from the same end user’s foreign bank account to multiple, similar suppliers of dual-use products.
indicators.red_flag: One foreign end-user fanning small payments out to multiple similar dual-use suppliers
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C3 (Multi-originator funnel-in / fan-out network detection).

indicators.section: New Transactional and Behavioral Red Flags
indicators.flag: Parties to transactions listed as ultimate consignees or listed in the “consign to” field do not typically engage in business consistent with consuming or otherwise using commodities (e.g., other financial institutions, mail centers, or logistics companies).
indicators.red_flag: Ultimate consignee is a pass-through (FI / mail-center / logistics), not an end-user
indicators.rationale: Partially covered by C22 (Trade-based money-laundering & documentary anomaly detection); data D15.

indicators.section: New Transactional and Behavioral Red Flags
indicators.flag: The customer is significantly overpaying for a commodity based on known market prices.
indicators.red_flag: Commodity over-pricing vs known market value (TBML over-invoicing)
indicators.rationale: Partially covered by C22 (Trade-based money-laundering & documentary anomaly detection); data D15.

indicators.section: New Transactional and Behavioral Red Flags
indicators.flag: The customer or its address is similar to one of the parties on a proscribed parties list, such as the BIS Entity List, the SDN List, or the U.S. Department of State’s Statutorily Debarred Parties List.
indicators.red_flag: Customer / address near-match to BIS Entity / SDN / Debarred-Parties list (watchlist screening)
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C18 (Sanctions / watchlist screening).
